title.en: den gamle by in the christmas season.
title.de: den gamle by in der weihnachtszeit.

line.en: the open-air old town is open 10:00 to 17:00 until 31 december. brass bands play in the streets at weekends, so walk the lanes around 14:00.
line.de: das freilichtmuseum hat bis 31. dezember von 10 bis 17 uhr offen. am wochenende spielen blasorchester in den gassen, also gegen 14 uhr durch die gassen gehen.
line.tr: açık hava eski kent 31 aralığa kadar 10:00 ile 17:00 arası açık. hafta sonları sokaklarda bando çalıyor; 14 civarında sokaklarda yürü.

sparks.why: Christmas in Den Gamle By runs 14 Nov to 31 Dec 2026 with daily hours 10:00 to 17:00 (visitdenmark.com); brass bands at weekends (visitaarhus.com).
